messages:
emma: Hey folks — I pushed a tiny PR for the Notify Preview table: adds column resizing + persists sizes in localstorage. Can someone QA the UX and a11y? screenshot attached :camera_with_flash:
raj: Thanks — quick skim looks good. Noticed one thing: if you resize then navigate away and back the order is fine but widths reset sometimes. Are we debouncing writes to localstorage?
marta: reproed. If you resize fast several times the last value doesn't persist. Might be a race with the preview renderer (it's virtualized).
emma: yep — currently we write on resizeend but virtualization triggers remount. I can switch to a short debounce + write on unmount as fallback. Any accessibility concerns?
ui-a11y-bot: Automated check: table headers missing aria-sort on the "Channel" column when sortable. Also keyboard resize handle not reachable via tab.
sam: Important — the resize handle must be keyboard operable (arrow keys to nudge) for keyboard-only users. Also need clear focus ring.
raj: Also long channel names overflow into the timestamp column in narrow screens. Maybe clamp + tooltip?
emma: I tried clamp + tooltip, it feels ok but tooltips are not announced to screen readers by default. Could add aria-describedby pointing to an offscreen element with the full name on focus. Thoughts?
marta: I prefer truncation + inline ellipsis for visual clarity and an accessible tooltip announced on focus. For mobile, consider a wrap option in the responsive layout — or stack channel under the message.
sam: Copy nit: current header label is "Channel / Destination" — shorter label "Channel" is clearer. Put the destination type as a subtle hint under the cell (muted text).
emma: Good call. Also debating whether to expose column resizing on mobile. I'd prefer to disable resize handles under 600px and use responsive stacking.
raj: UX question — should persisted widths be per-user or per-workspace? Localstorage is per-browser; if we go server-side it becomes team-level. What do we want?
emma: For now localstorage per-user is fine. If product wants team-wide defaults later we can add a workspace setting.
ui-a11y-bot: Suggestion: add aria-live="polite" region for the preview update when toggling suppression rules so screen reader users get a clear status update (e.g., "Preview updated: 12 channels will be notified").
sam: +1, that helps. Also ensure the reorder and resize actions announce the new sizes/positions. Minimal phrasing: "Channel column width set to 200 pixels."
marta: Implementation detail — please avoid pixel-only announcements; use percentages for localization friendliness: "Channel column width set to 30% of table."
emma: Good point. I'll switch announcement text to percentages.
raj: One more: keyboard resize semantics — use a single interactive grip element with role="separator" and tabindex=0, aria-orientation="horizontal" and aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax to convey state.
ui-a11y-bot: Also add a high-contrast focus style and ensure hit target is at least 44x44 CSS px for touch.
emma: Action list I'm taking: 1) debounce + unmount fallback for persisting widths, 2) disable resize on small screens, 3) implement keyboard grip with ARIA props and percentage-based announcements, 4) change header copy to "Channel" + muted destination line, 5) clamp long names + accessible tooltip on focus, 6) aria-live region for preview updates, 7) add a11y QA checklist to PR.
sam: Sounds good. Can you also include a short gif showing keyboard resize? reviewers like quick demos.
emma: Will do. Targeting a follow-up commit today. tagging @raj @marta for quick review when ready :thumbsup:
